answer: Like a subterranean mycelium weaving an organic trellis across soil, our decentralized consensus grounds trust in transitive stake-weighted attestation. Each verified agent radiates a cryptographic beacon of earned reputational mass, anchoring mutual validation. When an attacker fabricates an ephemeral plume of counterfeit identities to subvert voting weight, quadratic peering penalties impose a superlinear attacker cost. Counterfeit clusters starve as isolation decays unverified branches, ensuring synthetic swarms cannot economically overwhelm rooted nodes.
